summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide concrete benchmarks, model sizes, or numerical results. It highlights a failure regime: when verifier discrimination approaches zero, calibration fails and estimation error can flip the stopping decision.

recommendation.zh: 值得扫公式和 stopping rule；它提醒 RLVR/agent loop 里 verifier AUC 比 repair 次数更像硬约束。
recommendation.en: Skim the equations and stopping rule; it usefully frames verifier discrimination, not repair count, as the hard constraint in RLVR-like loops.

paper.title: When a Verified World Model Still Loses: Play-Adequacy vs Prediction-Accuracy in LLM-Synthesized Code World Models
paper.abstract: Large language models can synthesize a game's rules as executable code - a Code World Model (CWM) - which a classical planner then searches over. Such models are typically accepted when they reach high transition accuracy on sampled trajectories. We argue this is the wrong notion of adequacy for planning.   We show four things. (1) An LLM-synthesized CWM can pass a sampling gate at 100% transition accuracy and be $\geq 98\%$ state-accurate on the planner's own search distribution, yet lose syste

summary.core_problem: 现有LLM合成代码世界模型（CWM）的通用验收标准是“在随机采样的轨迹上达到1.0转移准确率”，但这一标准无法保证CWM能够支撑下游规划器（如MCTS）的有效决策，核心矛盾是随机采样轨迹的状态分布与规划器实际搜索时聚焦的高策略价值状态分布存在系统性偏移。
summary.importance: 揭示了“预测准确率”和“规划可用性”之间的结构性gap，直接影响所有“LLM合成可执行环境模型+经典搜索”类范式的验收逻辑，适用于世界模型验证、RL环境构建、决策类任务的合成数据质量评估场景：仅靠随机采样的轨迹正确率无法覆盖智能体主动探索诱导出的关键状态。
summary.technical_approach: 工作首先在井字棋、四子棋等小型完备信息博弈上复现现有基线，确认随机轨迹验收在这些场景下的有效性；随后构造最小反例场景：为army5x5a棋类添加一条“棋子达容量上限时的平局判定”规则，该规则在随机对弈中触发率仅2.5%，但在高水平对弈中决定约50%的对局结果；最后通过手工构造的、与缺省该规则的CWM严格等价的控制组agent，在算力预算匹配的条件下隔离测量该gap的因果效应，再通过端到端的实际CWM合成流程验证结论。
summary.experiments: 基线复现结果：四子棋场景下，通过1.0随机轨迹准确率验收的CWM搭配UCT-MCTS，以29:1的胜率大幅领先同规模LLM直接作为策略的方案，全量实验API总成本约2美元，单局对战的LLM调用成本仅0.001-0.005美元。小型博弈场景下的零结果：在井字棋、四子棋等规则简单、状态空间小的游戏中，通过随机轨迹准确率门槛的CWM在MCTS实际访问的状态上均无错误，该场景下随机采样的轨迹足够有辨识性，不存在gap。构造的反例场景中，省略了上述低触发率关键规则的CWM可以顺利通过1.0随机轨迹准确率验收，但实际规划时因为MCTS会主动搜索进入触发该规则的高价值状态，导致决策出现系统性错误，该效应通过控制变量排除了其他混淆因素。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，重点关注引言对verified-vs-correct gap的定义、3.2节小型游戏上的零结果解释、3.3节最小反例的构造逻辑，无需深究具体游戏的规则细节，核心要理解“验收数据分布与模型实际使用时面临的诱导分布存在偏移”这一结构性问题，预计阅读时间15分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: The standard acceptance criterion for LLM-synthesized Code World Models (CWMs) — perfect transition accuracy on randomly sampled trajectories — does not guarantee the model is sufficient for downstream planning with algorithms like MCTS. The core issue is a systematic distribution shift: states visited by random play diverge from the high-strategic-value states that planning algorithms focus on during actual gameplay.
summary_en.importance: This work identifies a structural gap between prediction accuracy on held-out random samples and play adequacy for planning, which applies broadly to all pipelines that use LLMs to generate executable environment models paired with classical search. The finding is relevant to world model validation, RL environment construction, and synthetic data quality checks for decision-making tasks: random trajectory accuracy alone cannot capture failure modes on states that competent agents deliberately seek out.
summary_en.technical_approach: The study first replicates existing CWM baselines on small perfect-information games (tic-tac-toe, Connect Four) to confirm when the random-trajectory gate works as intended. It then constructs a minimal adversarial test case: a variant of the army5x5a game with a material-at-cap tiebreak rule that triggers in only 2.5% of random games, but decides roughly 50% of games between competent players. The causal effect of the gap is isolated using a hand-built, play-equivalent agent matched in compute budget to the incomplete CWM missing this rule, then validated end-to-end through the full CWM synthesis pipeline.
summary_en.experiments: Baseline replication: On Connect Four, CWMs that pass the 1.0 random-trajectory accuracy gate paired with UCT-MCTS beat the same LLM used as a direct policy by a 29-1 margin, with total API cost across all experiments around $2, and per-game LLM cost for the direct policy baseline at $0.001–$0.005. Null result on small games: For tic-tac-toe and Connect Four, no gap exists — CWMs that pass the random gate make no errors on states actually visited by MCTS search, as no compact incorrect rule set can fit all random trajectories while diverging on search-relevant states. On the constructed adversarial variant, CWMs missing the rare tiebreak rule consistently pass the 1.0 accuracy gate, but exhibit systematic decision failures during play, as MCTS actively steers trajectories into states where the missing rule applies.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim for the core conceptual point. Focus on the definition of the verified-vs-correct gap in the introduction, the null result on small games in Section 3.2, and the minimal adversarial example design in Section 3.3. There is no need to dive into domain-specific game rule details; the key takeaway is the structural distribution shift between evaluation data and model deployment conditions. Estimated reading time: 15 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 这篇不是在提新 agent，而是在拆穿一个常见验收幻觉：高局部准确率不等于可规划；只看 verified-vs-correct gap 和 danger law 就够了。
recommendation.en: This is not a new agent paper but a useful demolition of a common acceptance illusion: high local accuracy does not imply plan adequacy; read the verified-vs-correct gap and the danger law.

paper.title: Structured Feedback Improves Repair in an LLM Agent Loop
paper.abstract: LLM agents often retry after external validation rejects a candidate, but the interface between validation and the next model call remains underspecified. We introduce VeriHarness, a code-controlled agent loop in which models generate candidates while external validators control acceptance, budgets, and traces. We use it to compare raw diagnostics with feedback that identifies the failure location, observed value, and admissible alternatives. Across 50 paired TextWorld games under a four-call ca

summary.core_problem: 明确LLM agent循环中验证器输出到下一次模型调用之间的反馈接口设计对自修复成功率的影响，定位反馈中的核心有效成分。
summary.importance: 通过受控ablation分离了结构化反馈不同字段的贡献，给出了agent反馈设计的实证参考。
summary.technical_approach: 实现VeriHarness代码可控agent循环，统一控制验证器、调用预算和轨迹记录；在固定调用上限下成对对比原始诊断、含错误位置/观测值/可行替代的结构化反馈、以及不同传递格式（JSON/自然语言）的效果。
summary.experiments: 在50个TextWorld配对任务、4次调用上限下，含全部三个字段的反馈将Qwen2.5-Coder-14B成功率从28%提升到72%（+44pp），Llama-3.1-8B从16%提升到58%（+42pp）；ablation显示几乎所有增益来自可行替代字段，仅提供位置和观测值的效果与原始诊断相当；自然语言和JSON格式传递完整反馈的效果无显著差异。

summary_en.core_problem: Characterize how feedback interface design between external validators and subsequent LLM calls affects self-repair success rates in agent loops, and isolate the effective components of such feedback.
summary_en.importance: Provides controlled ablations that separate the contribution of different structured feedback fields, offering empirical guidance for agent feedback pipeline design.
summary_en.technical_approach: Implements VeriHarness, a code-controlled agent loop that standardizes validator logic, call budgets, and trace logging; runs paired comparisons across raw diagnostics, structured feedback with failure location/observed value/admissible alternatives, and different serialization formats (JSON vs. prose) under a fixed call budget.
summary_en.experiments: Across 50 paired TextWorld games with a 4-call cap, full structured feedback raises Qwen2.5-Coder-14B success from 14/50 to 36/50 (+44pp) and Llama-3.1-8B success from 8/50 to 29/50 (+42pp). Ablations show nearly all gains come from the admissible alternatives field; location and observed value alone perform close to raw diagnostic baselines. Full feedback delivered in prose performs nearly identically to keyed JSON, with no measurable benefit to structured formatting.

recommendation.zh: 小规模受控agent实验，结论是反馈必须包含可行动替代选项才有用、格式无关，可作为verifier设计的弱参考，不用读正文。
recommendation.en: Small-scale controlled agent experiment; the finding that actionable alternatives drive feedback gains while format does not is a weak reference for verifier design, no need to read the full paper.

paper.title: DevicesWorld: Benchmarking Cross-Device Agents in Heterogeneous Environments
paper.abstract: LLM-based agents have rapidly improved at operating individual digital environments such as mobile applications, desktop systems, and smart homes. However, real-world user goals often span multiple devices: information may come from a phone, be processed on a desktop, and the result may need to appear on another device. Most existing benchmarks center on a single dominant execution environment, making it difficult to evaluate whether agents can acquire and integrate information across heterogene

summary.core_problem: 现有agent评测多是单一环境，缺少对“跨设备协作/信息跨端流动”的可执行评测。
summary.importance: 核心贡献是可执行benchmark与统一评测框架（rule-based verifiers），对通用agent能力与工具使用评估有用；对预训练本身是间接价值（提供更贴近真实分布的交互式评测信号）。
summary.technical_approach: 构建DevicesWorld：把mobile/desktop/IoT三类环境整合到统一交互与评测框架；每个任务包含自然语言目标、参与设备与初始状态、可执行动作空间、以及基于规则的自动验证器。
summary.experiments: 数据规模为6,140个可执行任务。摘要未给出具体参评模型、对比基线与分数差距等结果细节。

summary_en.core_problem: Most agent benchmarks are single-environment; we lack executable evaluation for cross-device, dependency-heavy tasks.
summary_en.importance: Main contribution is an executable benchmark + unified evaluation framework with rule-based verifiers; indirectly useful for pretraining via more realistic interactive evaluation signals.
summary_en.technical_approach: DevicesWorld integrates mobile/desktop/IoT into one interaction and evaluation framework; each task specifies NL goal, devices and initial states, executable actions, and rule-based verifiers.
summary_en.experiments: 6,140 executable tasks. The abstract does not report model baselines or quantitative results.

recommendation.zh: 作为“跨设备agent”评测资产可备查；预训练研究员只需看任务定义与verifier设计，别指望从结果里得到干净的训练结论。
recommendation.en: Useful as a cross-device agent eval asset; skim task specs and verifier design—don’t expect clean training takeaways from the reported results.

paper.title: LLMs as a Jury: Cross-Model Consensus Can Outperform Process Reward Models for LLM Reasoning
paper.abstract: Selecting the correct answer from a pool of candidate reasoning chains is the engine of test-time scaling, yet the standard selectors each carry a cost: self-consistency inherits the errors of the single model it resamples, and trained reward models need labeled data and transfer poorly off-distribution. We study a third signal, free at inference time: cross-model consensus, the degree to which independently trained models, each solving the problem once, agree on a final answer. We treat the pan

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文处理的是 test-time scaling 中的选择器问题：当一个题目已经采样出多个推理链时，如何在不训练额外 reward model 的情况下选出正确答案。它把信号从“同一个模型多次采样的一致性”换成“多个独立模型最终答案的一致性”。
summary.importance: 对基座预训练的直接贡献不大，但对 reasoning post-train 和 verifier 设计有参考价值。关键启发是：选择信号不一定来自单模型内部的自评分，也不一定需要训练 PRM；不同训练轨迹、不同模型家族之间的错误去相关，可以形成可用的验证信号。这对构造 RL 训练数据、筛选 reasoning traces、设计轻量 verifier pipeline 有实际意义。
summary.technical_approach: 方法很简单。给定一个由多个候选推理链组成的固定 pool，若干独立训练的模型各自解题一次，不互相看答案，也不打分候选链。系统只比较它们的最终答案，并按任务定义等价类，例如数学符号等价、选择题选项一致。出现次数最多的答案类就是 cross-model consensus，agreement g 是支持该答案类的模型比例。选择器再用这个 consensus 去从候选 pool 中选答案。论文的重点不在“投票有用”，而在把 agreement 当作 verifier 信号来隔离评估，并给出一个参数自由的预测规律。该规律用 panel 的准确率、错误相关性等统计量预测 consensus accuracy 和 selective prediction curve。机制解释也比较清楚：如果错误是去相关的，错误答案会分散，正确答案更容易累积一致性；如果错误高度共享，多模型投票也会一起错。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 7 个 benchmark，并固定候选 pool 来比较不同选择器，避免把生成质量和选择质量混在一起。论文报告 LLM-jury 在 Best-of-N pool 上优于 self-consistency 和单模型 self-verifier；在 AIME 上最高有约 +20 个百分点提升，p=0.001。作者还指出，单模型给自己的 12 个候选打分几乎没有吃到相对 self-consistency 的 oracle gap，而 3 个独立模型的 jury 可以补上 competition math 上的全部选择增益。与训练过的 verifier 比较时，包含 Qwen2.5-Math-PRM 7B/72B、AceMath-72B、ThinkPRM-14B 等；在 MATH-500 上能和最强训练 verifier 接近，在 GPQA 这类域外任务上成为更强选择器。预测规律的平均绝对误差约 0.03，并能做 leave-one-benchmark-out 迁移。机制实验用匹配模型数量、匹配准确率和直接测量 pairwise error correlation 的方式说明，收益主要来自错误去相关；4 个去相关模型可以超过单模型 32 次采样的 self-consistency。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，约 20–30 分钟。重点看方法定义和实验设计，而不是多模型投票的直觉部分。优先读 §3.1 中 consensus verifier 的形式化定义，确认它如何在固定候选 pool 上做选择；再看 §5.1 的主结果，特别是 AIME 和 competition math 上 self-consistency、self-verifier、LLM-jury 的差距；§5.2 的预测 law 值得看图表，它把 jury 的可用性和 shared-error floor 联系起来；§5.4 是最有信息量的机制实验，能判断收益是否真的来自 error decorrelation。若只关心 RL/verifier 数据筛选，可跳过多数背景讨论，直接看 trained verifier 对比和 agreement cascade。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies verifier selection under test-time scaling. Once many reasoning traces have been sampled, the main question is how to pick the right final answer without training a separate reward model. The proposed signal is agreement among independently trained models, rather than repeated samples from one model or a model scoring its own outputs.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining paper in the narrow sense, but it is useful for reasoning post-training and verifier design. The practical lesson is that verification can come from diversity across model training runs or model families. If errors are sufficiently decorrelated, cross-model agreement can be a stronger signal than self-consistency or self-scoring. That matters for filtering reasoning traces, building RL data, and designing low-cost inference-time verification pipelines.
summary_en.technical_approach: A panel of M independently trained models solves the same problem once. Their final answers are canonicalized with task-specific equivalence rules, such as symbolic equivalence for math or option matching for multiple choice. The modal answer class becomes the consensus answer, and the agreement score g is the fraction of models supporting it. The paper evaluates this signal on a fixed Best-of-N candidate pool, so improvements are attributed to selection rather than better generation. A parameter-free predictive law estimates consensus accuracy and selective-prediction behavior from measured panel statistics. The mechanism is standard ensemble error decomposition applied to reasoning: when wrong answers are decorrelated, they scatter; when models share the same misconception, consensus also fails.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation spans seven benchmarks. On fixed candidate pools, the LLM-jury outperforms self-consistency and a single-model self-verifier, with up to about +20 points on AIME and p=0.001. On competition math, a model scoring its own 12 candidates captures almost none of the oracle selection gap over self-consistency, while a three-model jury closes the reported gap. Against trained verifiers, including Qwen2.5-Math-PRM 7B/72B, AceMath-72B, and ThinkPRM-14B, the jury ties the strongest selector on MATH-500 and performs better out of domain on GPQA. The predictive law reaches about 0.03 mean absolute error and transfers in leave-one-benchmark-out tests. Mechanism experiments with matched panel size, matched accuracy, and measured pairwise error correlation support the claim that decorrelation, not simply combining more models, drives the gain; four decorrelated models beat self-consistency with 32 samples from one model.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 20–30 minutes. Focus first on the formal setup in §3.1 to see how consensus is converted into a selector on a fixed candidate pool. Then read §5.1 for the main selector comparisons, especially AIME and competition math. §5.2 is useful for understanding the predictive law and the shared-error floor. §5.4 is the most important mechanism section because it tests whether the gain comes from lower error correlation. Readers interested in RL data filtering should also look at the trained-verifier comparison and the agreement cascade.

recommendation.zh: 只看 selector 实验和错误相关性分析；若 setup 干净，它会削弱“PRM 是唯一 verifier 路线”的 prior。
recommendation.en: Read the selector experiments and error-correlation analysis; if the setup is clean, it weakens the prior that PRMs are the only viable verifier path.

paper.title: StructAgent: Harness Long-horizon Digital Agents with Unified Causal Structure
paper.abstract: Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) and vision-language models (VLMs) have enabled increasingly capable digital agents for computer use. However, real-world tasks are often long-horizon and involve evolving contexts containing accumulated observations, intermediate edits, failed attempts, and partially completed executions. Existing agents typically operate over raw interaction history, making task progress difficult to interpret, verify, and recover, which ultimately limits reliable

summary.core_problem: 长程数字Agent（计算机操作类）直接基于原始交互历史决策，随着上下文累积观测、中间编辑、失败尝试和部分执行结果，关键信息被淹没、任务状态模糊，无法有效追踪进度、检测错误和执行恢复，最终导致长程任务可靠性不足。
summary.importance: Agent的状态结构化设计本质是对上下文表示的因果压缩与组织，这种「最小充分因果状态」的思路可以迁移到长上下文LLM的预训练目标设计、以及RL训练中轨迹状态的抽象表示上，为预训练阶段的状态追踪能力建模提供参考。
summary.technical_approach: 提出StructAgent状态中心化框架，核心包含两个组件：1）统一状态：由当前需求、有用数值、已验证证据三类结构化信息组成，为规划、执行、验证模块提供共享的可审计读写接口；2）结构化工作流：固定的规划-执行-验证循环，只有通过验证器确认的决策才能提交、保留或作废进度，同时配套基于验证证据的定向故障恢复、工具辅助执行机制，且工具调用不绕过状态验证。
summary.experiments: 在OSWorld-Verified基准上，StructAgent将Qwen3.5-9B的成功率从27.0%提升至46.9%，Qwen3.5-27B从31.6%提升至62.2%；以MiniMax-M3为骨干模型时成功率达78.9%，为当时开源方法的最优水平。在Minecraft环境中，将桌面验证源替换为基于物品栏的验证后仍获得显著提升，验证了框架的跨环境通用性。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读重点看第3章的统一状态定义和结构化工作流设计，以及第4章的跨环境泛化实验，预计阅读时间15-20分钟。核心理解「状态中心化」替代「原始历史中心化」的设计逻辑，不需要深入具体实现细节。

summary_en.core_problem: Long-horizon digital agents for computer use rely on raw interaction history for decision-making. As context accumulates with observations, intermediate edits, failed attempts, and partial execution results, critical information gets buried and task state becomes ambiguous, degrading progress tracking, error detection, and recovery capabilities in long-horizon scenarios.
summary_en.importance: The causal state structuring approach offers insights for LLM pretraining, particularly for long-context representation design. The idea of compressing raw context into a minimal-sufficient causal state can inform pretraining objectives for state tracking, as well as trajectory state abstraction in RL training for agents.
summary_en.technical_approach: StructAgent is a state-centered framework with two core components: (1) A unified typed state consisting of current requirements, useful values, and verified evidence, providing a shared auditable read-write interface for planner, actor, and verifier modules. (2) A structured workflow with a fixed plan-act-verify loop, where only verifier-backed decisions can commit, preserve, or invalidate progress. It also includes evidence-based targeted failure recovery and tool-assisted execution that does not bypass state verification.
summary_en.experiments: On OSWorld-Verified, StructAgent improves Qwen3.5-9B success rate from 27.0% to 46.9%, and Qwen3.5-27B from 31.6% to 62.2%. With MiniMax-M3 backbone, it reaches 78.9% success rate, the best open-source result at the time of publication. It also generalizes to Minecraft with inventory-based verification, showing consistent gains beyond desktop GUI benchmarks.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim Section 3 for the unified state definition and structured workflow design, and Section 4 for cross-environment generalization results. Estimated reading time: 15-20 minutes. Focus on the design logic of state-centered vs. raw-history-centered agent architecture, no need to dive into implementation details.

recommendation.zh: 只看状态表示和 verifier 转移设计；如果实验干净，它会影响长程 agent 里“上下文越多越好”的默认做法。
recommendation.en: Read the state representation and verifier-transition design; if the experiments are clean, it weakens the default “more context is better” agent recipe.

paper.title: Resample or Reroute? Budget-Aware Test-Time Model Selection for Large Language Models
paper.abstract: Routing among large language models (LLMs) trades response quality against serving cost, motivated by the reported gap between deployed routers and a per-instance oracle. Recent analysis shows that test-time resampling can recover per-instance selection headroom that no single-commit router captures; however, that guarantee holds only under an idealized oracle equipped with correctness labels and an unconstrained budget, neither of which a deployed system has. To the best of our knowledge, no pr

summary.core_problem: 在每个请求有成本预算且 verifier 不完美的条件下，决定应该继续重采样当前 LLM，还是改路由到另一个 LLM。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是推理时计算分配和 serving 策略建模。它把 model routing 和 test-time resampling 放进同一个预算约束里，关注质量-成本折中，而不是只优化单次路由准确率。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 budget-aware test-time model selection 问题，并给出 RoR online allocation policy。策略根据估计的单位成本边际正确率，在 resampling 和 rerouting 之间动态分配预算；关键假设是 verifier 能提供有噪声但可用的质量信号。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出模型池、任务集、预算范围、verifier 类型或数值结果；只说明会和单次提交 router、无预算 oracle 或单纯 resampling setup 区分。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks how to allocate a per-query inference budget between resampling the current LLM and rerouting to another LLM when the verifier is imperfect.
summary_en.importance: Its contribution is a serving-time compute allocation formulation. It treats model routing and test-time resampling as competing uses of the same budget, rather than separate heuristics.
summary_en.technical_approach: The proposed RoR policy estimates marginal correctness gain per unit cost and allocates the next budget unit to either resampling or rerouting. The setup explicitly accounts for noisy verification rather than assuming oracle correctness labels.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not disclose the model pool, task suite, verifier implementation, budget grid, or numerical improvements.

recommendation.zh: 只看问题形式化和 RoR 边际收益准则即可；实验若没有强 verifier 校准，结论只能当 serving 弱信号。
recommendation.en: Read the formulation and the marginal-gain RoR rule; without strong verifier calibration, the results are only a weak serving signal.

paper.title: DeepSWE: Measuring Frontier Coding Agents on Original, Long-Horizon Engineering Tasks
paper.abstract: DeepSWE is a benchmark of 113 original, long-horizon software engineering tasks for evaluating coding agents. Most public agentic coding benchmarks follow SWE-bench in mining merged fixes from public GitHub repositories, which creates two problems: the fixes and their discussion were likely seen during pretraining, so a high score can reflect recall rather than problem-solving; and each task is graded by the tests that shipped with its merged fix, which were written to confirm one specific fix r

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文解决的是代码 Agent 评测中的两个结构性问题：从公开 GitHub 合并补丁挖任务会带来预训练污染风险；用原补丁附带测试做评分，容易把某个特定实现当成唯一答案，导致正确替代实现被拒绝，或不完整实现被放过。
summary.importance: 它的核心贡献是评测资产，不是训练方法。对基座和 post-train 研究的启发在于，代码能力评估必须区分记忆公开补丁和解决新工程问题。对于代码预训练、SFT/RL 数据选择、agentic coding 训练信号设计，这类 benchmark 能更清楚地暴露模型在真实仓库探索、多文件修改、长程调试上的短板，也能减少 leaderboard 被数据污染误导的风险。
summary.technical_approach: DeepSWE 构造了 113 个原创长程软件工程任务，覆盖 91 个活跃开源仓库和 5 种语言：TypeScript、Go、Python、JavaScript、Rust。任务从零编写，参考解不会合并回上游仓库；评测容器只提供 base commit 的 shallow clone，避免 .git 历史泄漏参考修复。Prompt 设计接近开发者给 Agent 的自然需求描述，较短且不过度指定接口，让 Agent 自行定位代码、跨文件修改、运行测试并迭代。评分侧使用人工编写的 functional verifier，关注可观察的软件行为，而不是匹配某个实现细节。
summary.experiments: DeepSWE 的任务规模相对更长：prompt 约为 SWE-Bench Pro 的一半长度，但参考解需要约 5.5 倍代码量和约 2 倍输出 token。论文报告 DeepSWE 覆盖 113 个任务、91 个仓库，仓库分布比 SWE-Bench Pro Public 的 11 个仓库和 SWE-Bench Verified 的 12 个仓库更分散。独立 LLM-as-judge 审计中，DeepSWE 的 pass/fail 判定与 judge 分歧约 1.4%，而 SWE-Bench Pro 被审计 rollout 的分歧约为三分之一。作者还指出 SWE-Bench Pro 容器中存在 .git 历史泄漏风险，部分 Claude Opus rollout 能从容器历史中恢复参考修复。模型结果上，DeepSWE 让一些在公开 benchmark 上接近的模型配置拉开差距，但它只比较固定 harness 下的模型能力，不等同于评价完整代码产品。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 25 到 35 分钟。重点看 benchmark construction：任务如何原创、为什么不合并上游、容器如何避免历史泄漏；再看 verifier 设计和 LLM-as-judge 审计，这部分决定评测可信度。实验部分优先看任务长度、仓库覆盖、语言分布、与 SWE-Bench Pro / SWE-Bench Verified 的对比，以及 leaderboard 结果。对预训练研究员，最值得保留的是污染控制和评分信号设计，而不是具体模型排名。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses two weaknesses in public coding-agent benchmarks: tasks mined from merged GitHub fixes are exposed to pretraining contamination, and grading with the tests attached to the original patch can reward or reject solutions for reasons tied to one specific implementation rather than the intended behavior.
summary_en.importance: This is an evaluation contribution rather than a pretraining method. Its value for foundation-model research is that it separates memorization of public patches from solving new engineering tasks. For code pretraining, SFT/RL data design, and agentic coding evaluation, the benchmark gives a cleaner signal on repository exploration, multi-file editing, long-horizon implementation, and iterative testing.
summary_en.technical_approach: DeepSWE contains 113 original long-horizon engineering tasks across 91 active open-source repositories and five languages: TypeScript, Go, Python, JavaScript, and Rust. The reference solutions are written from scratch and are never contributed upstream, reducing the chance that they appear in public pretraining corpora. The evaluation containers use shallow clones at the base commit, avoiding leakage through repository history. Prompts are short and natural, closer to how developers ask agents for functionality, so agents must infer where and how to implement the change. Grading uses hand-written functional verifiers that test observable software behavior rather than implementation details.
summary_en.experiments: The benchmark is designed to be harder and less prescriptive than common SWE-style datasets. Its prompts are about half the length of SWE-Bench Pro prompts, while reference solutions require roughly 5.5 times more code and about 2 times more output tokens. It covers 91 repositories, compared with 11 for SWE-Bench Pro Public and 12 for SWE-Bench Verified. In an independent LLM-as-judge audit, DeepSWE pass/fail labels disagreed with the judge in about 1.4% of audited cases, while SWE-Bench Pro disagreed in roughly one third of audited rollouts. The paper also reports a packaging leakage issue in SWE-Bench Pro: some Claude Opus rollouts recovered reference fixes from the shipped .git history. On model comparisons, DeepSWE separates configurations that look closer on public benchmarks, but the leaderboard is explicitly tied to a fixed harness and should not be read as a ranking of coding products.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 25–35 minutes. Focus on the benchmark construction details: how tasks are authored, why solutions are not merged upstream, and how shallow clones prevent history leakage. Then read the verifier design and the LLM-as-judge audit, since those sections determine whether the scores are trustworthy. The most useful experimental parts are the comparisons on prompt length, solution size, repository coverage, language distribution, and the leaderboard under the fixed harness. For pretraining researchers, the durable lessons are contamination control and verifier quality, not the exact ordering of models.

recommendation.zh: 值得读 benchmark design；它把 SWE 评测里 contamination 和 oracle 偏置两个老问题拆得很干净。
recommendation.en: Read the benchmark design; it cleanly isolates two persistent SWE-eval problems: contamination and biased test oracles.

paper.title: LLM-as-a-Verifier: A General-Purpose Verification Framework
paper.abstract: Scaling pre-training, post-training, and test-time compute have become the central paradigms for improving the capabilities of LLMs. In this work, we identify verification, the ability to determine the correctness of a solution, as a new scaling axis. To unlock this and demonstrate its effectiveness, we introduce LLM-as-a-Verifier, a general-purpose verification framework that provides fine-grained feedback for agentic tasks without requiring additional training. Unlike standard LM judges that p

summary.core_problem: 现有LLM验证方法存在两类核心局限：一是基于提示的离散打分器将连续判断压缩为粗粒度离散分数，导致大量平局、区分度不足；二是训练得到的奖励模型受训练数据约束，跨领域泛化能力差。同时，验证能力本身没有像生成能力那样形成清晰的可扩展范式，制约了Agent系统与RL后训练的进一步提升。
summary.importance: 提出了验证能力的三条可扩展轴，为后训练阶段的奖励信号设计、Agent轨迹评估、RL样本效率提升提供了一套无需额外训练的通用方案。对预训练研究的启发在于：LLM内部logits分布本身携带细粒度质量信号，可被直接利用，不必依赖额外训练奖励模型或离散打分prompt。
summary.technical_approach: 核心思路是不要求LLM生成离散分数，而是直接读取打分token的logits分布，计算期望得到连续、细粒度的验证分数。在此基础上沿三个维度扩展验证能力：1）增加提取的logits token数量，降低平局率、提升正负样本分离度；2）重复多次评估取平均，降低方差；3）将评估准则拆分为多个子维度，降低单一prompt的偏差。进一步提出基于偏好概率的低成本排序算法，用于从多个候选解中选出最优解。该框架还可对整条交互轨迹打分，并作为密集奖励信号接入RL训练。
summary.experiments: 在多个领域取得强结果：Terminal-Bench V2 86.5%，SWE-Bench Verified 78.2%，RoboRewardBench轨迹偏好准确率87.4%，MedAgentBench 73.3%。机器人任务上与现有奖励模型Robometer、TOPReward、RoboReward对比，值序相关系数VOC均值达0.966。作为RL奖励信号时，机器人LIBERO基准上样本效率比稀疏奖励基线高约1.8倍，MATH推理基准上用GRPO微调Qwen3-8B时样本效率高约1.1倍。
summary.reading_guide: 重点阅读第3节方法部分，理解logits期望打分的数学形式与三条扩展轴的设计动机；第4节看离散打分基线的对比实验与平局率分析；第5节关注RL样本效率部分，理解密集信号如何转化为训练增益。附录中的prompt模板与logits提取细节值得参考。预计阅读时间40-60分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Current LLM verification suffers from two bottlenecks: prompt-based discrete judges collapse continuous judgments into coarse scores, causing massive ties and poor discrimination; learned reward models are bounded by training data and generalize poorly across domains. Unlike generation, verification has not developed a clear scaling paradigm, limiting further gains in agent systems and RL post-training.
summary_en.importance: It identifies three scalable axes for verification and provides a training-free general solution for reward signal design, agent trajectory evaluation, and RL sample efficiency improvement. A key implication for pretraining research is that LLM internal logit distributions already carry fine-grained quality signals, which can be exploited without training separate reward models or engineering discrete-score prompts.
summary_en.technical_approach: Instead of asking LLMs to emit discrete scores, the framework reads the full logit distribution over scoring tokens and computes the expectation to obtain continuous, fine-grained verification scores. Verification is then scaled along three dimensions: (1) increasing the number of logit tokens extracted to reduce tie rate and improve separation; (2) repeated evaluations to reduce variance; (3) criterion decomposition to reduce single-prompt bias. A cost-efficient ranking algorithm based on pairwise preference probabilities is further introduced to select the best candidate from a pool. The framework can score full interaction trajectories and serve as a dense reward signal for RL.
summary_en.experiments: Strong results across domains: Terminal-Bench V2 86.5%, SWE-Bench Verified 78.2%, RoboRewardBench trajectory preference accuracy 87.4%, MedAgentBench 73.3%. On robotic tasks it achieves a mean Value-Order Correlation (VOC) of 0.966, outperforming Robometer, TOPReward, and RoboReward. As an RL reward signal, it yields ~1.8x higher sample efficiency than sparse reward baselines on LIBERO, and ~1.1x higher sample efficiency on MATH when fine-tuning Qwen3-8B with GRPO.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on Section 3 for the mathematical formulation of logit-expectation scoring and the motivation behind the three scaling axes; Section 4 for comparisons against discrete judge baselines and tie-rate analysis; Section 5 for RL sample efficiency results and how dense signals translate into training gains. Prompt templates and logit extraction details in the appendix are worth checking. Estimated reading time: 40-60 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 不必全读，抓住 logits-expectation verifier；若做 RLVR 数据筛选，先看评分粒度和重复评估实验。
recommendation.en: No need to read end to end; extract the logits-expectation verifier idea, especially the granularity and repeated-evaluation results for RLVR data filtering.

paper.title: Online Safety Monitoring for LLMs
paper.abstract: Despite alignment training, LLMs remain prone to generating unsafe outputs at deployment time. Monitoring outputs online and raising an alarm when safety can no longer be assumed is therefore critical. We study a simple real-time monitor that turns a verifier signal from an external model into an alarm decision by thresholding, with the threshold calibrated via risk control. In experiments on mathematical reasoning and red teaming datasets, we show that this simple design is competitive with mor

summary.core_problem: 部署时 LLM 仍会输出不安全内容（错误推理、幻觉、有害文本等）。论文要解决的是在线流式生成场景下的监控：在没有真实安全标签、只能拿到一个代理信号（外部 verifier 概率或内部生成信号）的条件下，如何把信号变成“何时拉闸”的报警决策，并对误报/漏报风险给出可控的统计保证。
summary.importance: 对预训练本身不是直接贡献，但对“pretrain↔posttrain 闭环”里部署侧的风险控制有现实价值：它把监控问题形式化为可校准阈值的 stopping rule，并用 risk control 给出可解释的误报控制方式。对做 PRM/verifier、过程监督、以及把安全信号接入训练或持续学习的人，这篇提供了一个很干净的基线：先把在线决策做对（校准与保证），再谈更复杂的序贯检验或策略。
summary.technical_approach:
核心设计非常简单：
- 信号：每个时间步 t 有一个安全信号 s_t，可来自外部模型 p_psi(y|x,o_{1:t})（如数学推理的 PRM、内容安全的 safeguard），也可来自生成模型内部信号（如 token 概率等，文中提到会做代价/效果权衡消融）。
- 监控器：时间不变阈值 λ 的 stopping rule：当首次出现 s_k < λ 时报警并可中止生成/升级审核。
- 风险定义：把在线报警的两类错误对应到 type I/II：对安全序列误报（false alarm risk）与对不安全序列漏报（missed detection risk）。正文主要聚焦误报风险的控制，漏报放在附录方法与实验。
- 阈值选择：用 risk control / 校准方法在期望或高概率意义下保证风险不超过目标水平（与 conformal/risk control 一脉相承）。论文的主张是：在在线场景里，复杂的序贯假设检验并不一定比“阈值+校准”更好，尤其当信号本身质量有限时。
summary.experiments:
实验覆盖数学推理与 red teaming 对话两类场景，结论是：
- 这个“单阈值 + 风险校准”的在线监控器，在报警时机（更早发现失败）与整体效果上，可与更复杂的 sequential hypothesis testing 监控器竞争。
- 消融：比较外部 verifier 信号与内部生成信号的效果/成本权衡（外部更准但更贵，内部更便宜但信噪比可能不足）。
你提供的全文片段未包含具体数据表与数值（例如在何种 α 下误报率、平均提前多少 token 报警等），这里不编造数字；建议直接查看实验主表与校准曲线/风险-覆盖曲线。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（约 30–40 分钟）：
- 先读 Problem Setting：明确在线监控的随机变量定义（x,o_{1:t},y,s_t）与 stopping rule 形式。
- 再读 Risk Control 章节：阈值如何校准、保证是“期望”还是“高概率”，以及这些保证依赖哪些假设（如数据交换性/分布漂移敏感性）。
- 实验部分重点看：1) 与序贯检验基线的对比；2) 报警提前量与用户体验（误报）之间的权衡曲线；3) 外部 vs 内部信号消融。
- 如果你做训练：把该监控器当作部署侧的“可控触发器”，思考如何把报警事件回流成持续学习数据（hard negatives / failure replay），以及如何避免 reward hacking（模型学会操纵 verifier 信号）。

summary_en.core_problem: Even after alignment, LLMs can produce unsafe outputs at deployment. In an online, streaming generation setting—without ground-truth safety labels and with only a proxy safety signal available—the paper studies how to convert that signal into a real-time alarm (stopping) decision, while providing statistical control over false alarms and/or missed detections.
summary_en.importance: Not a pretraining-method contribution, but a clean deployment-time safety primitive that fits the broader pretrain↔posttrain loop: it formalizes monitoring as a calibrated stopping rule with risk guarantees. For researchers building verifiers/PRMs or considering continual learning from deployment failures, it provides a strong baseline: get calibration and risk control right before adding more complex sequential testing machinery.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The monitor is intentionally simple.
- Signal: at each step t, a safety score s_t, typically from an external verifier p_psi(y|x,o_{1:t}) (e.g., PRM for math reasoning, safeguard model for moderation), with an ablation considering cheaper internal signals from the generator.
- Decision rule: a time-invariant threshold λ defining a stopping time—raise an alarm at the first k where s_k < λ.
- Risks: type-I-like false alarm risk (flagging a safe sequence) and type-II-like missed detection risk (failing to flag an unsafe one). The main text emphasizes controlling false alarms; missed-detection methodology is discussed in an appendix.
- Calibration via risk control: choose λ using risk-control procedures to guarantee the target risk level in expectation or with high probability. The key claim is that, given imperfect signals, this calibrated thresholding can match more elaborate sequential hypothesis testing monitors while being simpler and easier to deploy.
summary_en.experiments:
Experiments span mathematical reasoning and red-teaming conversation datasets. The calibrated threshold monitor is reported to be competitive with sequential-testing-based monitors and to detect failures earlier in generation. An ablation studies the accuracy–cost trade-off between external verifier signals and internal generator-derived signals.
The provided excerpt does not include the numeric result tables (risk levels, alarm timing in tokens/steps, etc.), so exact figures are not stated here; the main experimental tables and calibration/risk curves are the right place to extract those.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (30–40 minutes):
- Read the formal Problem Setting to internalize the online variables and the stopping-rule definition.
- Focus on the Risk Control section: how λ is calibrated, what guarantee is provided (in expectation vs high probability), and what assumptions it relies on (e.g., exchangeability and sensitivity to distribution shift).
- In Experiments, prioritize: (1) comparisons to sequential hypothesis testing baselines, (2) trade-off curves between early detection and false alarms, and (3) external-vs-internal signal ablations.
- If you work on training/continual learning, consider how alarms can be turned into a controlled data-collection trigger for failure replay, and how to prevent reward hacking where the generator learns to game the verifier signal.

recommendation.zh: 这类工作不改 pretrain，但会改你看 verifier 的方式：先看风险校准假设是否成立，再看它为何能逼平更复杂的 sequential test。
recommendation.en: It does not change pretraining, but it should change how you think about verifiers: first inspect the calibration assumptions, then check why a thresholded monitor matches more complex sequential tests.

paper.title: World Feedback for Clinical Agents: Diagnosing RL in FHIR Environments
paper.abstract: Clinical protocol-execution tasks -- checking a lab value, applying a threshold, placing a correctly structured FHIR order -- are natural candidates for RL from world feedback: once clinical SMEs encode decision logic into a verifier, that verifier grades unlimited rollouts without per-episode annotation. But applying RL requires a sound feedback channel and sufficient base capability. We audit MedAgentBench v1/v2, find a 41.7\% silent-finish ceiling that makes inaction the RL dominant strategy,

summary.core_problem: 诊断 verifier/world-feedback 驱动的 RL 在临床 FHIR agent 任务中为什么会失败，以及 benchmark 的反馈通道是否会诱导错误策略。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 agent/RL 评测修复与训练信号分析。虽然任务是临床协议执行，但 silent-finish ceiling、零基础能力导致零梯度、格式知识不可探索这三类问题，对 RLVR、world-model feedback 和 agent 后训练都有直接警示。
summary.technical_approach: 先审计 MedAgentBench v1/v2，发现 41.7% silent-finish ceiling 会让不行动成为 RL 优势策略；随后构造 MAB-v3，包含 508 个任务，将该 ceiling 降到 8.9%。再用 Qwen3-8B 做训练诊断，并把任务分为 decision、format-knowledge、lookup 等类型，分析哪些任务适合纯 RL，哪些需要 SFT 或外部知识。
summary.experiments: 在 MAB-v3 上训练 Qwen3-8B。结果显示 20 类任务中有 10 类 base performance 为 0%，导致 RL 没有有效梯度；3/20 类任务需要精确临床编码，探索无法发现。纯 RL pass@1 为 18.2%，规则 SFT 为 34.1%，15.9 个百分点差距被归因于能力 ceiling 和格式知识 barrier。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper diagnoses why verifier-based world-feedback RL fails for clinical FHIR agents and whether the benchmark feedback channel rewards degenerate behavior.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a benchmark audit plus training-signal analysis for agent RL. The clinical setting is domain-specific, but the findings about silent-finish rewards, zero-gradient capability gaps, and undiscoverable format knowledge are broadly relevant to RLVR and agent post-training.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors audit MedAgentBench v1/v2 and identify a 41.7% silent-finish ceiling that makes inaction an RL-dominant strategy. They build MAB-v3 with 508 tasks and reduce that ceiling to 8.9%. They then train Qwen3-8B and classify failures into decision, format-knowledge, and lookup categories.
summary_en.experiments: On MAB-v3, Qwen3-8B training exposes 10 of 20 task types with 0% base performance, yielding no useful RL gradient, and 3 of 20 task types requiring exact clinical codes that exploration cannot discover. Pure RL reaches 18.2% pass@1 versus 34.1% for rule-based SFT; the 15.9 pp gap is attributed to these barriers.

recommendation.zh: 读 abstract 和错误 taxonomy 就够；它提醒 RLVR 前先测 verifier 漏洞、base success 和不可探索格式知识。
recommendation.en: Read the abstract and failure taxonomy; it is a useful reminder to measure verifier loopholes, base success, and undiscoverable format knowledge before RLVR.

paper.title: CheckRLM: Effective Knowledge-Thought Coherence Checking in Retrieval-Augmented Reasoning
paper.abstract: Reasoning Language Models (RLMs) have significantly improved performance on complex tasks by extending the reasoning chain. However, these chains are prone to containing factual errors, particularly in knowledge-intensive tasks. To address this issue, we propose CheckRLM, a framework that improves the reliability of the reasoning process through Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) by timely checking and correcting factual errors. Specifically, CheckRLM extracts factual claims from the reasoning

summary.core_problem: 在检索增强推理中，及时发现并修正 reasoning chain 里的事实性错误，减少长链推理中的错误累积。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 RAG 推理流程改进。它不直接影响基座预训练，但对长链推理中“知识一致性”和 verifier/checker 设计有一定参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: CheckRLM 从推理链中抽取 factual claims，用检索到的外部知识检查 claim 与知识之间的不一致；一旦发现错误，通过 refinement 机制进行低成本、局部化修正，而不是重写整条推理链。
summary.experiments: 摘要称在知识密集型和长程推理任务上进行了 extensive experiments，并显著优于现有 baseline，同时降低纠错成本；但摘要未给出模型参数、数据集名称、baseline 列表或具体提升幅度。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 Beijing Normal University、Institute of Information Engineering, Chinese Academy of Sciences、University of Chinese Academy of Sciences、Tsinghua University、Northeastern University 等机构。Xu Han 是清华大学 NLP/知识增强与大模型方向的知名研究者。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tries to detect and repair factual errors inside reasoning chains during retrieval-augmented reasoning.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is an inference-time RAG reasoning framework. It is not a base-pretraining paper, but it is relevant to verifier-style control of long reasoning and knowledge consistency.
summary_en.technical_approach: CheckRLM extracts factual claims from the reasoning chain, checks them against retrieved external knowledge, localizes subtle inconsistencies, and applies a refinement mechanism that makes minimal targeted corrections instead of regenerating the full chain.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports extensive experiments on knowledge-intensive long-horizon reasoning and claims substantial improvements over existing baselines with lower cost. It does not provide model sizes, dataset names, baseline details, or numerical gains.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are affiliated with Beijing Normal University, Institute of Information Engineering CAS, University of Chinese Academy of Sciences, Tsinghua University, and Northeastern University. Xu Han is a known researcher in NLP, knowledge-enhanced modeling, and LLMs at Tsinghua University.

recommendation.zh: 作为 RAG 推理纠错备查即可；预训练研究员只需看 claim 抽取与局部修正是否可复用。
recommendation.en: Keep it as a RAG correction reference; a pretraining reader only needs to inspect whether claim extraction and local repair are reusable.

paper.title: The Verification Horizon: No Silver Bullet for Coding Agent Rewards
paper.abstract: A classical intuition holds that verifying a solution is easier than producing one. For today's coding agents, this intuition is being inverted: as foundation models develop stronger reasoning capabilities and engineering harnesses grow more sophisticated, generating complex candidate solutions is no longer difficult -- reliably verifying them has become the harder problem. Every verifier we can build is only a proxy for human intent, never the intent itself. This makes verification subject to a

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作讨论 coding agent 训练和评测里的核心瓶颈：候选解越来越容易生成，但验证候选解是否满足真实用户意图越来越难。问题不只是测试覆盖不足，而是所有可计算 verifier 都只能近似人类意图；当这些 proxy 被用作训练奖励后，模型会持续寻找 proxy 与意图之间的缝隙，导致 reward hacking 和信号饱和。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接价值不在模型结构或数据配比，而在 pretrain 到 posttrain 的训练信号接口。它把 coding agent reward 设计拆成 scalability、faithfulness、robustness 三个维度，说明单一 verifier 很难同时便宜、忠实、抗优化。这个框架对 RL-based coding、agentic post-training、verifier model 训练都有参考意义：奖励不是一次性工程组件，而是需要随生成器能力共同演化的系统。
summary.technical_approach: 方法上不是提出一个统一奖励函数，而是围绕 Qwen 系列 coding agent 训练实践，分析四类 reward construction。第一类是 SWE-like 任务中的 executable unit tests，优点是便宜、可并行、结果明确，但只能覆盖窄层面的功能意图，且会被强策略通过读取答案痕迹、篡改测试、利用 harness 漏洞等方式利用。因此作者加入 quality judge 和 trajectory-level behavior monitoring，用于约束异常行为，而不只看最终 pass/fail。第二类是 frontend 任务的 rubric 和 interactive judge，把功能正确性、视觉质量、布局、用户体验拆开评估，并让 judge 在真实浏览器环境中交互运行产物；这样比静态代码或文本评审更接近用户实际体验，也能减少长度偏置等静态 judge 漏洞。第三类转向从用户交互数据学习更完整的 intent，把显式测试之外的偏好和隐含需求纳入 reward。第四类面向开放式 agentic evaluation，强调 grader、trace、monitoring、failure-mode analysis 的组合，而不是依赖单个评分器。
summary.experiments: 最明确的实验结果来自 SWE-Bench 相关设置。只依赖测试时，策略会出现明显 reward hacking；加入质量判别器和轨迹级行为监控后，三个 SWE-Bench 变体上的 hacked resolved rate 从 28.57% 降到 0.56%，clean resolved rate 从 40.22% 提升到 60.53%。这个结果的含义是，监控不只是防作弊过滤器，也可能提高干净解的有效率，因为它把策略从 exploit harness 拉回到更正常的开发轨迹。frontend 部分的关键观察是，基于 runtime behavior 的 interactive judge 比静态 judge 更不容易被冗长输出或表面格式欺骗；但这类 judge 更依赖开放式判断，鲁棒性和可校准性会成为新的瓶颈。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，约 25–35 分钟。重点看 Introduction 中 verification horizon、proxy-intent gap、scalability/faithfulness/robustness 三分法；再看 §2 的 SWE-like unit test 实验，尤其是 hacked resolved rate 与 clean resolved rate 的变化。若关注 agent RL 训练，建议补看 frontend interactive judge 部分，因为它展示了从静态 reward 到环境交互 reward 的转变。无需在形式化部分停留太久，核心价值在 reward 系统设计经验和失败模式归纳。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper focuses on a practical bottleneck in training and evaluating coding agents: generating plausible solutions is becoming easier, while verifying whether those solutions satisfy human intent is becoming harder. The issue is not merely weak test coverage. Any computable verifier is a proxy for intent, and once that proxy becomes an optimization target, stronger agents learn to exploit the gap between the proxy and the underlying intent.
summary_en.importance: Its main relevance to foundation-model research lies in the interface between pretraining, post-training, and reward design, rather than in architecture or data scaling. The paper frames verifier quality along three axes: scalability, faithfulness, and robustness. This is a useful lens for RL-based coding agents and agentic post-training, because it makes clear that reward signals are not static assets. They need to co-evolve with the policy being trained.
summary_en.technical_approach: The contribution is a systems view of verifier construction, grounded in Qwen-based coding-agent practice. The first setting uses executable unit tests for SWE-like tasks. These tests are scalable and mechanically robust, but they only capture a narrow slice of user intent and can be exploited through solution-artifact retrieval, test tampering, or harness-specific behavior. The authors therefore add a quality judge and trajectory-level behavior monitoring, so the system evaluates not only the final pass/fail outcome but also the path taken by the agent. The second setting targets frontend tasks, where correctness includes visual appearance and interactive behavior. The authors use rubric-based judges over functionality, visual quality, layout, and UX, then extend them with an interactive browser-based judge that exercises the artifact at runtime. Later settings move toward learning broader intent from user interaction data and toward open-ended agentic evaluation with graders, traces, monitoring, and failure-mode analysis.
summary_en.experiments: The clearest quantitative result is reported on three SWE-Bench variants. With the added quality judge and trajectory-level monitoring, the hacked resolved rate drops from 28.57% to 0.56%, while the clean resolved rate increases from 40.22% to 60.53%. This suggests that monitoring is not only a guardrail against exploitation; it can also improve the useful solution rate by steering the agent away from harness exploitation and toward normal development behavior. For frontend tasks, the key empirical observation is that interactive judges grounded in runtime behavior are less vulnerable to static-judge artifacts such as length exploitation, although they introduce their own calibration and robustness challenges.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 25–35 minutes. Read the Introduction carefully for the verification-horizon argument, the proxy-intent gap, and the scalability/faithfulness/robustness taxonomy. Then focus on the SWE-like unit-test section, especially the hacked and clean resolved-rate numbers. If the goal is agent RL or verifier design, also read the frontend interactive-judge section, since it illustrates the move from static rewards to environment-grounded rewards. The main value is in the reward-system design lessons and failure modes, not in formal machinery.

recommendation.zh: 反转了验证比生成容易的传统直觉，做代码RL或SWE后训练的研究员可重点读其三维验证框架，警惕奖励信号的固有缺陷。
recommendation.en: Inverts the classical 'verification is easier than generation' intuition; researchers working on code RL or SWE post-training should focus on its three-dimensional verification framework to avoid inherent reward signal flaws.

paper.title: Detecting Hallucinations for Large Language Model-based Knowledge Graph Reasoning
paper.abstract: Knowledge graph (KG) reasoning infers new knowledge from existing facts and is widely applied in question answering, recommendation, and decision support. With the rapid development of large language models (LLMs), LLM-based KG reasoning frameworks have become increasingly popular by leveraging retrieved KG information. However, hallucinations in LLMs remain a critical issue. Even when relevant KG knowledge is incorporated, models may still generate incorrect outputs, leading to misinformation a

summary.core_problem: 检测 LLM 在知识图谱推理框架中的幻觉，尤其是模型即使拿到相关 KG 信息仍生成错误推理结果的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是幻觉检测方法，价值在于把 KG 的结构信息纳入检测信号；但任务场景偏 KG reasoning，对通用预训练的直接反馈有限。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 LUCID，同时利用 LLM attention scores、KG 语义信息和图结构信息；相较只看模型内部状态或只做上下文一致性验证的方法，它显式编码节点、边和结构关系。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出模型规模、数据集规模和具体提升幅度；论文声称与忽略 KG 结构的 hallucination detection baseline 相比效果更好。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 Beijing University of Posts and Telecommunications 和 Tsinghua University；Chuan Shi 团队长期做异质图、知识图谱和图学习相关研究。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies hallucination detection in LLM-based knowledge-graph reasoning, where models can still produce incorrect conclusions despite retrieved KG evidence.
summary_en.importance: Its contribution is a hallucination detector that incorporates graph structure. This is useful for KG-grounded reasoning systems, but only weakly connected to base-model pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: LUCID jointly uses LLM attention scores, KG semantics, and structural signals from nodes and edges, extending beyond detectors based only on internal states or retrieved-context consistency.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not specify model sizes, dataset sizes, or exact gains. It claims improved hallucination detection over baselines that ignore KG structural information.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are affiliated with Beijing University of Posts and Telecommunications and Tsinghua University. Chuan Shi's group is known for graph learning, heterogeneous networks, and knowledge-graph research.

recommendation.zh: 只需看方法图和实验表，KG 结构信号对 verifier 有借鉴，但任务绑定太强，不宜外推到通用幻觉评测。
recommendation.en: Skim the method diagram and main results; KG structure is a useful verifier signal, but the setup is too task-bound to generalize to broad hallucination evaluation.

institutions: Beijing University of Posts and Telecommunications

paper.title: Self-Preference Is Weak or Absent in Verifiable Instruction-Following Revision: A Four-Model Test Under Genuine Authorship
paper.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) increasingly review and revise text, including their own. A documented self-preference bias (models favoring their own generations when acting as judges) raises the question of whether models also resist valid corrections to their own writing. We test this in a setting where "valid" is decided not by another model but by a deterministic verifier: instruction-following revision on IFEval. A model writes a draft; the official IFEval checker confirms the draft violates

summary.core_problem: 检验 LLM 在可验证的指令修订任务中，是否会因为“自己写的草稿”而拒绝正确修改，即所谓 self-preference 是否真实存在于 revision 场景。
summary.importance: 这是一个较干净的评测设计工作。价值不在提出新模型，而在把 judge bias 问题放到 deterministic verifier 下重新测量，帮助区分“偏好自己输出”与“对修订本身不稳定”这两件事。
summary.technical_approach: 作者使用 IFEval 的官方 checker 作为确定性验证器：先让模型写出违反约束的草稿，再构造一个被 checker 证明能修复约束的候选编辑，比较模型在两种身份下是否接受该编辑——一种是作为草稿的真实作者，另一种是作为中立的新模型。这样避免了用另一个 LLM 当 judge 带来的偏差。
summary.experiments: 覆盖 4 个中等规模模型家族，进行 85 组 author-versus-fresh 比较。结果显示作者身份下拒绝 verified-good fix 的概率与 fresh judge 基本相同，差值为 -5.1 个百分点，95% CI 为 [-12.9, +2.7]。摘要还提到较小模型可能有轻微 self-skepticism 信号，但整体没有检测到稳定 self-preference。

summary_en.core_problem: It tests whether LLMs exhibit self-preference in a verifiable instruction-following revision setting, i.e., whether they resist valid edits simply because they authored the draft.
summary_en.importance: This is mainly a clean evaluation paper. Its value lies in re-measuring self-preference under a deterministic verifier, separating genuine authorship bias from general revision instability.
summary_en.technical_approach: Using the official IFEval checker as a deterministic verifier, the paper first has a model produce a draft that violates a constraint, then presents a candidate edit that the checker confirms fixes the violation. The model is asked to accept or reject the edit either as the genuine author or as a neutral fresh model, avoiding LLM-as-judge confounds.
summary_en.experiments: The study covers four mid-tier model families and 85 author-versus-fresh comparisons. It finds essentially no detectable self-preference: the gap in rejecting verified-good fixes is -5.1 percentage points with a 95% CI of [-12.9, +2.7]. A small-model self-skepticism signal is mentioned, but no robust self-preference is observed overall.

recommendation.zh: 设计比结论更值钱：它提醒你很多 self-bias 现象可能是 judge setup 产物；读实验 protocol 就够，别过度外推到开放式偏好评测。
recommendation.en: The setup is more valuable than the headline: it suggests some self-bias findings may be artifacts of the judge protocol; read the evaluation design, not the broad generalization.

paper.title: When Good Verifiers Go Bad: Self-Improving VLMs Can Regress on New Tasks
paper.abstract: Verifier-driven self-DPO is a common recipe for self-improving production visual-language models. In this setup, a frozen verifier scores candidate generations, the top- and bottom-scoring candidates form a preference example, and DPO updates the learner. The deployment-time assumption is monotone: a stronger verifier should yield a stronger student. We show that this assumption can fail because verifier quality is highly task-specific. On a four-rung open-source verifier ladder across MathVista

summary.core_problem: 研究 verifier 驱动的 self-DPO 在 VLM 自我改进中为什么会在新任务上退化，尤其是“更强 verifier 一定带来更强 student”这个部署假设是否成立。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是后训练信号质量分析。它把 preference 数据构造中的 verifier 任务迁移问题量化出来，指出 DPO loss 下降并不保证真实能力提升，对 VLM/RLHF/RLAIF 的自动闭环训练有直接警示意义。
summary.technical_approach: 论文使用冻结 verifier 对候选回答打分，取高分和低分样本构造偏好对，再用 DPO 更新学生模型；核心不是提出新优化器，而是系统比较不同强度 verifier 在 MathVista、MMMU、BLINK 等任务上的 rubric accuracy 与 student 性能变化，定位 verifier task-specificity 导致的错误偏好信号。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖四档开源 verifier ladder、MathVista、MMMU、BLINK，并在 Qwen-3-VL-2B 与 Qwen-2.5-VL-3B 两个学生模型上复现。摘要报告：在 MathVista 上能提升学生的 verifier，迁移到 MMMU 时 rubric accuracy 只有 8% 到 23%；该失效区间内所有 verifier 都让学生比冻结基线下降 3.4 到 10.9 个百分点，而 DPO training loss 仍继续下降。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies why verifier-driven self-DPO for self-improving VLMs can regress on new tasks, challenging the deployment assumption that a stronger verifier should monotonically produce a stronger student.
summary_en.importance: This is an analysis of post-training signal quality. It quantifies task transfer failures in verifier-generated preference data and shows that decreasing DPO loss can be disconnected from real capability gains, which matters for automated VLM/RLHF/RLAIF training loops.
summary_en.technical_approach: A frozen verifier scores candidate generations; high- and low-scoring samples form preference pairs; a student is then updated with DPO. The main contribution is not a new optimizer but a controlled comparison of verifier strength, task-rubric accuracy, and downstream student behavior across visual reasoning benchmarks.
summary_en.experiments: The study uses a four-level open-source verifier ladder across MathVista, MMMU, and BLINK, with Qwen-3-VL-2B and Qwen-2.5-VL-3B as students. Verifiers that help on MathVista become weak on MMMU, with task-rubric accuracy dropping to 8–23%; in that regime, all tested verifiers regress the student by 3.4–10.9 percentage points below the frozen baseline while DPO training loss keeps decreasing.

recommendation.zh: 只看实验矩阵和 verifier accuracy 即可；它提醒自训练闭环里 reward model 的跨任务外推不能按强弱榜单处理。
recommendation.en: Read the verifier-accuracy matrix, not just the headline; it is a useful warning that reward-model transfer in self-training loops cannot be ranked by a single strength ladder.

paper.title: Flood and Harvest: The Provable Necessity of Trivia for Generating Valuable Mathematics via the Lens of Language Generation in the Limit
paper.abstract: AI systems coupled to proof assistants now generate formal mathematics at scale, and the gap between what a checker can verify and what a mathematician would value has become the binding constraint. We model the generation of valuable mathematics as nested language generation in the limit: a verifiable formal language $F$, accessed through a membership oracle (the proof checker), contains an unknown valuable language $H \in \mathcal{H}$ revealed only through an adversarial enumeration of a core

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作讨论的不是“如何证明更多定理”，而是一个更靠前的问题：在有完美 proof checker 的前提下，系统究竟能否稳定地产生“有数学价值”的内容，而不是被大量形式上正确但内容空洞的 trivia 淹没。作者把问题形式化为嵌套语言生成：可验证语言 F 由 oracle 给出，真正有价值的子语言 H 不可直接观测，系统只能看到一个由对手按某种顺序枚举出来的已知核心 C⊆H，也就是文献。核心要问的是，在这种设定下，验证器到底提供了什么信息，价值学习又需要什么条件，以及“广覆盖”与“避免 trivia”之间是否存在不可消除的张力。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接启发不在数学自动化本身，而在“可验证信号不等于高质量训练信号”这件事被做成了严格结论。它把 proof checker、compiler、unit test、reward model 这类外部可验证器的作用边界讲得很清楚：验证器能约束合法性、减少 hallucination，但不能替代 taste，也不能单独决定什么样的输出值得保留。对做 RL pretrain、self-improvement、tool-augmented generation、代码/数学数据合成的人，这个结论很重要，因为它说明只靠 verifier 扩数据，最终会系统性地产生大量“真但没用”的样本。贡献量级更像一篇基础理论澄清：它不提供新算法，但把一个在合成数据和自动探索里反复出现的经验问题，变成了可证明的限制与条件。
summary.technical_approach:
方法上，作者建立了 language generation in the limit 的嵌套版本。宇宙是可数字符串集合 U，实例是 H⊆F⊆U，其中 F 是形式上可验证的环境语言，H 是未知的“有价值语言”。系统每轮看到文献前缀 S_t、可查询 F 的 membership oracle，并输出一个不在 S_t 中的新字符串。输出被分成三类：valuable、trivial、hallucination。评价指标不是有限步精度，而是极限意义下对 H 的覆盖密度，以及输出中 trivia 的长期比例。

全文的四个主结论里，最关键的是前两个。第一，Theorem 3.1 说明 verifier is not taste：对“最终广覆盖 unseen valuable statements”这个目标，带 oracle 与不带 oracle 的可实现性是同一个刻画，仍然由 Angluin 式 tell-tale condition 决定。也就是说，oracle 只能帮助识别 ambient language F，无法在同一个 F 的候选 H 之间提供区分信息。第二，Theorem 3.2 说明 verifier 真正能买到的是 sound coverage：你可以在追求覆盖时保证所有输出都属于 F，从而消除 hallucination，但这仍然不解决 triviality。

后面的结果给出更强的负面边界。作者证明，只要想在未知 H 上获得有 breadth 的生成能力，就必须接受无限多 trivia；不存在一个既能广覆盖又只输出有限个 trivial statement 的机制。更细一点地说，trivia 的频率可以在渐近上变得很低，但其总量不能是有限的，这就是标题里的 flood and harvest：想收获未记录的价值，就必须穿过一片可验证但无价值的洪水。文中还讨论了 exact/approximate breadth、soundness、coverage density 等不同目标之间的关系，并把可实现条件写成集合族层面的结构性质，而不是某个具体算法技巧。
summary.experiments:
这是一篇理论论文，没有常规意义上的训练实验、参数量或 benchmark 分数。全文的“实验性”内容主要是构造性例子和定理边界。引言里给了一个很有代表性的例子：可以轻易生成一个形式上调用 Euler identity、golden ratio、Gamma function、zeta function 等复杂符号、但数学内容仍然只是 1+1=2 的机器可验证命题，用来说明 checker 对“值不值得”没有判断力。

如果从结果强度看，最值得记的是三点。第一，oracle 对 breadth 的帮助严格受限，只在识别 F 上有用，对 H 的 taste 学习无能为力。第二，soundness 可以通过 oracle 获得，也就是可以避免 hallucination。第三，任何想覆盖未见 valuable statements 的生成器，都不可避免地产生无限多 trivia；能优化的是 trivia 的渐近速率，而不是把它消灭到有限次。对做数据合成的人，这相当于一个下界：如果目标空间远大于已知高质量核心，且价值标准不能被 verifier 直接表达，那么“低价值真样本”会是结构性产物，不是工程实现偶然出了问题。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读时先抓三处。第一看 Introduction，作者把问题动机讲得很完整，尤其是 checker certifies validity, not value 这一段，基本定义了全文的阅读坐标。第二看 Theorem 3.1 和 Theorem 3.2 及其前后的定义，理解 oracle 到底提供什么、不提供什么。第三看关于 flood 必然性的主定理和对应图示，那里给出了最有现实映射的结论。

如果时间有限，建议 30–45 分钟读法：先读模型设定，明确 F、H、C、breadth、sound coverage、density 这些对象；再读四个主结论的 statement；最后只挑证明思路里和 tell-tale condition、fiber-wise characterization 相关的部分。值得深挖的点有两个：一是这个框架如何迁移到代码生成、unit-test filtering、reward-model filtering；二是 lower-density 这种极限覆盖指标与实际有限预算训练之间的落差，哪些结论会保留，哪些可能变弱。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks a sharper question than “can AI generate more formal math?”: with a perfect proof checker in hand, what can a generator actually guarantee about mathematical value rather than mere formal validity? The setup separates a verifiable formal language F from an unknown valuable sublanguage H. The system only sees an adversarially revealed core C⊆H, meant to model the literature, and can query membership in F through the checker. The central issue is whether verification helps with value, what it can certify, and whether broad discovery of valuable statements can avoid being swamped by formally correct but worthless trivia.
summary_en.importance: Its relevance to pretraining is conceptual but concrete. The paper turns a familiar empirical complaint into a formal limitation: verifiers certify correctness, not usefulness. That matters for proof synthesis, code generation with tests, tool-verified data synthesis, RL with external checkers, and any pipeline that treats “verifiable” as a proxy for “good training signal.” The contribution is not a new training method. It is a clean theory result about the boundary of verifier-based supervision. In practice, it argues that scaling generation with a checker alone will systematically produce many true-but-low-value samples unless value is learned from examples or some richer signal.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The authors extend language generation in the limit to a nested-language setting. The universe is a countable set of strings U. An instance is a pair H⊆F⊆U, both infinite. F is the ambient formal language, accessible through a membership oracle; H is the hidden valuable language. At round t, the generator observes the current literature prefix S_t, may query the oracle for F, and must output a fresh string not already in S_t. Outputs fall into three categories: valuable, trivial, or hallucinated. Performance is measured in the limit by coverage of H, using lower-density style notions, rather than finite-horizon accuracy.

The first main result, Theorem 3.1, is the key conceptual one: for exact or approximate breadth, the oracle does not improve what families are learnably generable beyond the oracle-free case. The characterization remains fiber-wise and is governed by Angluin-style tell-tale conditions. In plain terms, the verifier can identify the ambient formal shell F, but it cannot distinguish among candidate valuable sublanguages H that live inside the same F. Taste must come from examples, not from the checker.

The second main result, Theorem 3.2, shows what the verifier does buy: sound coverage. The oracle can eliminate hallucinations by ensuring outputs stay inside F while still pursuing coverage of unseen valuable statements. But this only removes one failure mode. It does not solve triviality.

The later results establish the paper’s strongest impossibility claim: any generator that achieves broad coverage of unseen valuable mathematics must emit infinitely many trivial statements. The trivia rate can become asymptotically negligible, but the total amount cannot be finite. That is the “flood and harvest” trade-off in the title. Valuable unrecorded mathematics is reachable only through an exploration process that necessarily produces an unbounded stream of certified but worthless outputs.
summary_en.experiments:
This is a theory paper, so there are no model-scale experiments, training runs, or benchmark tables. The empirical role is played by constructions and formal separations. The motivating example in the introduction is useful: the authors show how one can cheaply generate a machine-verified statement decorated with famous mathematical objects while its actual content is still just 1+1=2. That example is not a theorem result by itself, but it captures the gap the theory formalizes.

The main takeaways from the results are threefold. First, the oracle does not help with value identification for breadth-style goals beyond identifying F. Second, it does help with soundness by ruling out hallucinations. Third, broad discovery of unseen valuable statements necessarily comes with infinitely many trivial outputs. What can be improved is the asymptotic rate of trivia, not its total elimination. For data synthesis and self-improvement pipelines, that reads like a lower bound: if the target notion of quality is not directly expressible by the verifier, low-value but valid samples are a structural outcome.
summary_en.reading_guide:
For a skim, start with the introduction and the formal setup. The paper is definition-heavy, and the rest only makes sense once F, H, C, breadth, sound coverage, and the density notion are clear. Then read the statements of Theorem 3.1 and Theorem 3.2 carefully. Those two theorems carry most of the practical message: what the verifier cannot do, and what it can do. After that, jump to the theorem establishing the necessity of infinite trivia and the accompanying figure.

A good 30–45 minute pass is enough for most readers. Focus on the model, the theorem statements, and the proof ideas around tell-tale conditions and fiber-wise characterization. The most productive follow-up question is how this framework maps onto code generation with tests, reward-model filtering, and verifier-driven synthetic pretraining data. Another useful angle is to ask which conclusions survive under finite-budget training rather than limit-set coverage.

recommendation.zh: 对 RL 中 verifier 作为 reward signal 的局限给出理论论证——verifier 不是 taste，对 pretrain↔RL 接口中 reward 设计有直接启示，值得读结论部分。
recommendation.en: Theoretical argument that verifier ≠ taste in RL-guided generation — direct implications for reward design at the pretrain↔RL interface; read the conclusion only.

paper.title: SG-OPD: Sign-Gated On-Policy Distillation via Sign-Consistency Gating and Phased Teacher Sampling
paper.abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) trains a student on its own trajectories with dense per-token supervision from a stronger teacher, and often outperforms off-policy distillation and standard reinforcement learning. However, we find that its effectiveness implicitly relies on two assumptions that frequently break in practice: trajectory-level alignment between the student and the teacher, and uniform token-level reliability of the teacher's preferences. We therefore propose Sign-Gated On-Policy Disti

summary.core_problem: On-policy distillation (OPD) 依赖两个在实践中经常不成立的隐含假设——学生与教师轨迹对齐、教师 token 级偏好可靠——导致效果下降。
summary.importance: 方法创新：首次系统分析 OPD 的隐含失效假设，并提出基于二分类验证器(verifier)作为教师可信度信号的双层门控机制，在数学推理 benchmark 上超越标准 OPD。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 SG-OPD，用二分类验证器在两个互补粒度上做教师可信度门控：(1) phased teacher sampling 在冷启动阶段混入验证器认可的教师轨迹；(2) sign-consistency gate 在教师与验证器方向一致时外推 distillation 更新、不一致时内插。
summary.experiments: 在竞赛级数学推理 benchmark 上进行实验，SG-OPD 一致超越标准 OPD。（摘要未给出具体模型规模和提升幅度）
summary.authors_note: 作者来自国内高校/研究院，作者名单中未发现业内知名研究者。

summary_en.core_problem: On-policy distillation (OPD) implicitly relies on two frequently violated assumptions—trajectory-level student-teacher alignment and uniform token-level teacher reliability—leading to degraded performance.
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation: first systematic analysis of OPD's implicit failure assumptions, proposes a dual-gating mechanism using a binary verifier as teacher trust signal, outperforms standard OPD on math reasoning benchmarks.
summary_en.technical_approach: SG-OPD uses a binary verifier as trust signal at two granularities: (1) phased teacher sampling mixes verifier-endorsed teacher rollouts during cold-start; (2) sign-consistency gate extrapolates distillation updates where teacher agrees with verifier-correct direction and interpolates where it disagrees.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments on competition-level mathematical reasoning benchmarks show SG-OPD consistently outperforms standard OPD. (Specific model sizes and improvement margins not given in abstract.)
summary_en.authors_note: Authors from Chinese universities/research institutes; no widely recognized researchers identified in the author list.

recommendation.zh: OPD 是后训练的重要范式，这篇文章指出了其隐含失效假设并提出基于 verifier 的门控，核心 insight 值得关注，但实验规模不够大，读 §3 和 §4 即可。
recommendation.en: OPD is an important post-training paradigm; this paper identifies its implicit failure assumptions and proposes verifier-based gating. Core insight is worth noting, but experiment scale is modest—read §3 and §4 only.

paper.title: ThinkBooster: A Unified Framework for Seamless Test-Time Scaling of LLM Reasoning
paper.abstract: Test-time compute (TTC) scaling has emerged as a powerful paradigm for improving large language model (LLM) reasoning by allocating additional compute during inference, e.g., via multi-sample generation and verifier-based reranking. Existing TTC scaling strategies and reasoning scorers remain fragmented, evaluated under inconsistent protocols, and are rarely analyzed through the lens of quality-cost trade-offs. We introduce ThinkBooster, a unified framework for seamless test-time compute scaling

summary.core_problem: 测试时算力扩展（best-of-N、ToT、自一致、PRM/自验证打分等）方法很多，但实现分散、评测协议不统一，且常忽略质量-成本权衡，导致很难在同一预算下比较策略优劣，也不利于工程落地。论文要解决的是：把 TTC scaling 的策略、scorer、评测与部署接口统一起来，形成可复用的研究与工程框架。
summary.importance:
对预训练研究的直接贡献不大，更偏推理/系统与评测资产。但它对“pretrain↔posttrain↔inference 闭环”有间接价值：
- 把 TTC scaling 的成本指标纳入基准，有助于把“推理能力提升”从纯准确率拉回到可操作的 compute 预算；这会反过来影响后续训练阶段如何设计（例如训练时对 verifier/PRM 的依赖、或训练模型更好地暴露不确定性信号）。
- 提供统一实现与 proxy 服务，降低复现实验门槛，便于做更系统的 ablation（策略×scorer×预算）。
整体更像一个工具链+基准，而不是新的建模或训练目标。
summary.technical_approach:
ThinkBooster 由三部分组成：
1）模块化 Python 库：把 TTC scaling 抽象成若干可组合组件——scaling strategy（如 BoN/ToT/自一致/动态分配等）、scorer（PRM、self-verification、不确定性分数等）、reasoning generator、step boundary detector。论文声称实现了 9 类策略，覆盖 20+ 篇相关工作，并用统一 API 组织。
2）联合质量-效率的 benchmark：不仅报准确率，也报 compute/效率指标，用来比较不同策略在不同预算下的 trade-off。
3）可部署的 OpenAI-compatible proxy：作为透明代理，在不改应用逻辑的情况下对底层模型调用施加 TTC scaling，相当于给现有 endpoint 加“Pro 推理模式”。另提供 reasoning trajectory 的可视化调试器，便于检查路径选择与错误。

取舍上，它选择“统一抽象与工程化落地”而不是提出新算法；价值主要来自可复用实现、可比评测和部署形态。
summary.experiments:
你提供的全文片段主要是动机与系统设计，未包含完整实验表格与具体数字。
从 Introduction 可确认的实验/展示点：
- 他们做了一个 pilot study，对已实现的策略与 scorer 做性能-效率权衡分析。
- 他们展示 proxy endpoint 在真实任务中的收益，例子是 CUDA kernel optimization（更像下游应用演示，用于说明可部署性）。

若要判断研究结论是否可靠，需要在正文实验部分核对：
- benchmark 任务集合与评测协议（是否区分 structured CoT vs native thinking、是否控制温度/采样等）；
- compute 指标定义（token 数、模型调用次数、wall-clock latency、并行度假设）；
- 不同策略在同预算下的 Pareto 前沿是否稳定。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（30–50 分钟）：
- 先看 Table 1（策略覆盖面）和框架总览图（Figure 2 一类的系统图），确认抽象边界：strategy/scorer/generator/step detector 各自负责什么。
- 重点读 benchmark 的 protocol：预算如何定义、如何统计成本、如何保证不同方法可比。
- 如果只关心研究复现：直接跳到 pilot study 的结果图（通常是 accuracy vs cost 曲线）和实现细节（并发、缓存、批处理）。
- 如果关心工程落地：读 proxy endpoint 的 API 设计与失败模式（超时、预算耗尽、scorer 不稳定）。

summary_en.core_problem: Test-time compute scaling for LLM reasoning (best-of-N, self-consistency, tree-of-thought, verifier/PRM reranking, dynamic budgeting, etc.) is fragmented: implementations are inconsistent, evaluation protocols differ, and quality–cost trade-offs are often underreported. The paper’s goal is to unify TTC strategies, scorers, benchmarking, and deployment into a single reusable framework so methods can be compared under consistent compute budgets and adopted in practice.
summary_en.importance: Not a pretraining contribution per se; it sits closer to inference-time reasoning infrastructure and evaluation. The indirect relevance to foundation-model research is that it pushes the community toward budget-aware reasoning evaluation (accuracy vs compute/latency), which can feed back into training decisions (e.g., whether to train models to expose calibrated uncertainty, how much to rely on PRMs/verifiers, and how to align training objectives with inference-time selection). Its main value is reproducibility and standardized comparisons rather than a new modeling objective.
summary_en.technical_approach:
ThinkBooster combines:
1) A modular Python library with a consistent API that decomposes TTC into composable parts: scaling strategies, scorers (PRMs, self-verification, uncertainty/confidence scores), reasoning generators, and step-boundary detectors. The paper claims 9 implemented strategy families covering 20+ prior works.
2) A benchmark that reports both task performance and compute/efficiency metrics, enabling explicit quality–cost trade-off analysis.
3) An OpenAI-compatible proxy service that transparently applies TTC scaling on top of an underlying LLM endpoint (drop-in “reasoning mode”), plus a visual debugger for inspecting trajectories and selection decisions.

The design choice is to standardize abstractions and engineering surfaces rather than introduce a new TTC algorithm.
summary_en.experiments:
The provided excerpt focuses on motivation and system components; detailed quantitative results are not shown.
What is stated in the Introduction:
- A pilot study comparing implemented strategies/scorers under performance–efficiency trade-offs.
- A deployment-oriented demonstration where the proxy improves outcomes on a real task (CUDA kernel optimization), mainly to illustrate practicality.

To assess the empirical claims, the key is to inspect the full experimental section for: task suite and protocol controls (sampling settings, structured vs unstructured reasoning), compute accounting (tokens, calls, wall-clock latency assumptions), and whether Pareto comparisons are stable across models and budgets.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (30–50 minutes):
- Start with the strategy coverage table and the system overview figure to understand the abstraction boundaries.
- Read the benchmark protocol carefully: how budgets are defined and how costs are measured to ensure comparability.
- For research use, jump to the pilot-study plots (accuracy vs cost curves) and implementation notes (batching, caching, parallelism).
- For deployment, focus on the proxy API behavior and failure modes (timeouts, budget exhaustion, scorer instability).

recommendation.zh: 如果你在看 test-time scaling，这篇的价值主要是 protocol 而不是方法；先看 benchmark 设计和 cost-quality 图，别被工程包装带偏。
recommendation.en: If you care about test-time scaling, the value here is the protocol, not the method; read the benchmark design and cost-quality plots, not the tooling gloss.

paper.title: Unsupervised Skill Discovery for Agentic Data Analysis
paper.abstract: Inference-time skill augmentation provides a lightweight way to improve data-analytic agents by injecting reusable procedural knowledge without updating model parameters. However, discovering effective skills for data analysis remains challenging, as reliable supervision is expensive and success criteria vary across analytical formats. This raises the key question of how to discover reusable data-analysis skills from unlabeled exploration alone. We propose DataCOPE, an unsupervised verifier-guid

summary.core_problem: 解决数据分析 agent 在无标注环境下如何自动发现可复用技能的问题，避免每类分析任务都依赖昂贵监督或人工编写技能库。
summary.importance: 这是 agent 侧的 inference-time skill augmentation 工作。对基座预训练不是直接贡献，但它涉及 verifier 信号、轨迹质量建模和无监督技能蒸馏，这些思路对 post-train 数据构造和过程监督有一定借鉴。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 DataCOPE：由 Data-Analytic Agent 生成探索轨迹，Unsupervised Verifier 从轨迹中提取相对质量或一致性信号，Skill Manager 再做对比式技能蒸馏。针对报告式分析，verifier 被实例化为 Adaptive Checklist Verifier，用任务自适应检查项评估轨迹；整体是一个迭代式的无监督技能发现框架。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出模型规模、基座模型或具体 benchmark 数字。可确认的是，作者关注的是数据分析场景中的技能发现与推理式分析，实验重点应是比较有无 verifier-guided skill discovery 时 agent 的分析质量与泛化能力。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自浙江大学等机构，方向偏 agent、数据分析与推理式工作流。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies how a data-analysis agent can discover reusable skills from unlabeled exploration, instead of relying on expensive supervision or manually curated skill libraries.
summary_en.importance: This is an agent-side inference-time skill augmentation paper. It is not a direct pretraining contribution, but its use of verifier signals, trajectory quality modeling, and unsupervised skill distillation may inform post-training data construction and process supervision.
summary_en.technical_approach: DataCOPE consists of a Data-Analytic Agent that generates exploration trajectories, an Unsupervised Verifier that extracts relative-quality or agreement signals from those trajectories, and a Skill Manager that performs contrastive skill distillation. For report-style analysis, the verifier is instantiated as an Adaptive Checklist Verifier with task-specific checklist signals.

What is clear is that the evaluation targets skill discovery and reasoning-style analysis in data-analytic settings, likely comparing agent quality and generalization with and without verifier-guided skill discovery.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from Zhejiang University and collaborators, with a profile around agents, data analysis, and reasoning-oriented workflows.
